Players Committee card image of [[BoShek, Gritty Smuggler (Errata)]] (PC-E1 image; no errata mark), printing: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. BoShek's deploy cost may not be increased. During battle, may use 1 Force to subtract 1 from opponent's just drawn destiny or cancel an attempt to cancel and redraw a destiny. Immune to attrition < 3.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a20089e/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/hires/boshek.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/hires/boshek.png] as of commit a20089e “Virtual Set 10 Remastered” (19 August 2024).
